name: Planar Partial Cubes Have Bounded Rank
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every planar partial cube has rank at most three and therefore belongs to the rank-at-most-$r$ class for every $r\ge3$.
proof: A partial cube of rank at least four has a $Q_4$ pc-minor, while planarity is preserved by pc-minors and $Q_4$ is nonplanar.
